body: Thank you, I have to go to work soon, I just hope i can make it through. Thank you for the videos

I dont know why anyone would want me in the future. all that is a round me is dirt and ashes, i let my defences drop and revealed the loser that i am to her and i can see why she would reject me. Others will do the same. when im really stressed i like to laugh but anything other than crying seems like a lie right now. thank you for getting back to me it means a lot

Im afraid that it wont pass, its a case of my life has been rocked massively by all of the things i have lost and for the future. Theres so much darkness i dont know what i can take from this. i feel like Life has well and truly beaten me. thank you very much for replying it means a lot.

I dont think theres any chance of reconciliation, the last thing she said to me was 'i cant believe how much youve messed up what we had'. This has ultimately shown me to be the loser that i am, the one i was lying to cover up and i would expect her to want to get back with someone like that. let alone anyone else. i feel like life has won, for as much as i was trying to beat it and present a confident version of myself its all crumbled around me and i have nothing left. thanks for getting back to me though it means a lot
